text_sanskrit: अयनेषु च सर्वेषु यथाभागमवस्थिताः । भीष्ममेवाभिरक्षन्तु भवन्तः सर्व एव हि ॥ १-११ ॥
itrans: ayaneShu cha sarveShu yathAbhAgamavasthitAH . bhIShmamevAbhirakShantu bhavantaH sarva eva hi .. 1-11 ..
translation: Therefore, all ye standing in your respective divisions (places) in the different ranks should chiefly guard Bhishma.
